name: command
title: Command Menu
description: A searchable command palette — filtered, grouped items with keyboard navigation, optionally inside a ⌘K dialog.

meta.whenToUse: A keyboard-first command palette — global ⌘K, action launchers, a filtered list of things to do or go to.
meta.whenNotToUse: Picking a form value — Command's check mark is visual only (Select, SearchableSelect or Combobox) — or a small static action menu (DropdownMenu).
